Natural lithium is 7.5% lithium-6, the isotope that breeds tritium. Both the Breeding Blanket and Lithium Target Rods need it enriched to at least 60%.
# Lithium Isotope Separator
Takes two Lithium Fluoride of one enrichment and gives one 20 points richer (the rest leaves as tails), 10 seconds a pass at 160 FE/t. Below 60% it makes Enriched Lithium Fluoride, which shows its assay; feed that back in. At 60% and above it makes Lithium-6 Fluoride. Three passes take natural lithium to 67.5%, so one Lithium-6 Fluoride costs eight Lithium Fluoride. Speed and Energy upgrades fit.

# Lead-Lithium
The blanket's breeder and coolant: a liquid metal that carries heat and breeds tritium in one.
- Chemical Reactor: four Lead Ingots, one Lithium-6 Fluoride and 100 mB of Hydrogen make four Lead-Lithium Ingots and 100 mB of Hydrofluoric Acid.
- Arc Melter: each ingot melts to 250 mB of Lead-Lithium.
The reactor takes it through Input ports and gives it back as Hot Lead-Lithium out of Hot Leg ports.
